# Getting help

1. **Open SSH Doctor on the TV first.**  The main screen says, in plain words, what's wrong with SSH and which button fixes it.  It runs through the Homebrew Channel, so it works even when SSH doesn't.
2. **Locked out?**  **Go back to password login** in the app turns the `alpine` password back on right away (and undoes keys only and your own password).
3. **The [README](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR#readme)** covers installing, every feature, and using the script over telnet.
4. **A question?**  Ask in [Discussions > Q&A](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR/discussions/new?category=q-a).
5. **Found a bug?**  Open a [bug report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR/issues/new?template=bug-report.yml) with the app's **Report for getting help** (or `sh ssh-doctor.sh report`).
6. **Tried it on your TV?**  A [TV report](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR/issues/new?template=tv-report.yml) helps, whether it worked or not.
7. **An idea?**  Post it in [Discussions > Ideas](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR/discussions/new?category=ideas).

Rooting the TV isn't covered here: see [cani.rootmy.tv](https://cani.rootmy.tv/) and the [webOS Homebrew project](https://www.webosbrew.org/).  Security problems go through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/LG-WEBOS-SSH-DOCTOR/security/advisories/new), never a public issue.
